input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds our preferred warranty position. 19.1 gives the professional and workmanlike standard plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty running from the later of delivery or acceptance and, for hosted Services, conformity throughout the entire subscription term (better than our 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law, no intentionally introduced malicious code, no functionality diminution and an open-source protection; and 19.4 provides the full remedy stack of prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer is limited to implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
